role: Animation.zenInterface helper that returns nil (instant change) under Reduce Motion.
toplevel: Header comment (lines 5-12) states interactive transitions must not animate without consulting Reduce Motion; only 1 production call site (GetMeBackView.swift:448) uses this helper.

units.does: Returns nil when reduceMotion is true, else the given animation.

flags.text: Header says interactive transitions must go through this helper, but it has one caller (GetMeBackView.swift:448); e.g. ToastBanner and the Zen button styles animate without consulting Reduce Motion.
